Serializes a UCC reply string to a byte buffer.

See also
UccSerializer::serialize_reply

This implementation is intended to be used together with a stream-oriented socket (SOCK_STREAM in UDS or TCP).

The framing protocol used in this implementation consists of a Line Feed ("LF") character (0x0A,
) added at the end of the reply.

Implements beerocks::UccSerializer.
